source: Riley RL, Cournand A. 'Ideal' alveolar air and the analysis of ventilation-perfusion relationships in the lungs. J Appl Physiol 1949; 1(12):825-847; West JB. Respiratory Physiology: The Essentials. 10th ed. Wolters Kluwer, 2016; Chapter 5.
claim: In ventilation-perfusion inequality modelled via the three-compartment Riley framework, low V/Q units (lowVqFraction 0.55, lowVqRatio 0.1) without shunt cause arterial hypoxemia at room air (PaO2 <= 65 mmHg) due to venous admixture from poorly ventilated units.
